source_feedback: V14 T00 and T00B worked, proving donor import and E001 transplant are valid; every generated case after T00B gave Bad Object Record and corrupt pink wires.
method: Keep the working 4x donor object stream and CDB wherever possible, then mutate terminal labels, generated-coordinate records, and first-unit stream shortening independently.

cases.description: Known-good control: exact supplied 4x object chunk and CDB inserted into E001.
cases.expected_result: Must work. If this fails, the test environment changed from V14 feedback.

cases.description: Only first donor unit terminal labels are changed from VT/X1 to A1/B1. Geometry, CDB, object count, and component records remain donor-exact.
cases.expected_result: If this fails, arbitrary two-character terminal label mutation is corrupting this donor family.

cases.description: All four donor units keep donor geometry/CDB but use unique A#/B# terminal labels.
cases.expected_result: If T01 passes but this fails, repeated-unit unique net labels are the failing boundary.

cases.description: All four donor units keep donor geometry/CDB and use the same N1/N2 labels on every unit.
cases.expected_result: If this passes while A#/B# fails, the exact label spellings or uniqueness policy matter.

cases.description: The failed V14 T05 generated 4x chunk, but all terminal labels are restored to donor labels VT/X1/V0/G0. CDB remains donor-exact.
cases.expected_result: If label-only cases pass but this fails, the corruption is in coordinate/component record mutation rather than terminal labels.

cases.description: Exact first donor unit only; original 50-byte right wire has its final byte set to FF; CDB contains only C1/L1/R1.
cases.expected_result: If this fails, shortening the 4x donor object stream is not safe with this DSN header/model.

cases.description: Exact first donor unit only; original 50-byte right wire has its final byte set to FF; CDB remains the full 4x donor CDB.
cases.expected_result: If T05 fails but this works, the object stream can be shortened but CDB table cardinality must remain donor-like.

cases.description: Exact first donor unit only; an extra FF byte is appended after the original 50-byte right wire, matching the V14 generated final-wire length.
cases.expected_result: If T05 works but this fails, V14's 51-byte final wire is invalid for a shortened one-unit stream.
